 TNN / Nov 14, 2026, 00:11 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Ahmedabad: As the festive glow faded across the city, so did the lingering warmth, with both daytime highs and nighttime lows settling back into their seasonal rhythm, signalling the gradual transition toward pleasant winter conditions. . According to India Meteorological Department (IMD), the city recorded a maximum temperature of 33.5°C — just 0.3°C above the seasonal average — while the minimum temperature dipped to a pleasant 18.3°C, hovering 0.6°C above normal. Residents can expect a crisp start to the weekend, with the mercury predicted to touch around 18°C on Saturday morning. Elsewhere across the state, weather patterns remained equally steady. Daytime temperatures stayed comfortably between 33°C and 35°C, while nights brought a gentle chill ranging from 17°C to 22°C. Naliya, true to its reputation as the state’s cold pocket, recorded the lowest minimum temperature on Friday at 17°C, with meteorologists expecting similar dry conditions to persist over the coming days.
